definition_zh: 小公牛；阉牛；去势的公牛
definition_en: a young bull, especially one that has been castrated and raised for meat or work
core_image: 犁田的阉牛，脖颈上架着木轭
scene: 田埂上农夫挥鞭，两头牛拖着犁慢慢走。The farmer steered the bullock through the muddy paddy field.
sceneCN: 这里 bullock 是「役用阉牛」（第 2 个义项：拉车犁田的牛）；句意是农夫赶着阉牛犁过泥泞的水田。

derivatives.zh: bullock 的基础词，义为「公牛」
近义词，义为「阉牛」（美式常用）
近义词，义为「阉牛，役牛」（复数 oxen）

senses.title: A young bull
senses.definition: a young male of cattle, not yet fully grown
senses.example: The bullock was still frisky in the spring pasture.
senses.exampleCN: 春天牧场里，那头小公牛还活蹦乱跳。
senses.why: The base word bull is shrunk with the diminutive -ock to name the young male.
senses.whyCN: bull 加上表「小」的后缀 -ock，构成幼年公牛之称。

senses.title: A castrated working ox
senses.definition: a castrated bull raised for draught work or beef
senses.definitionCN: 为拉车、犁田或产肉而阉割的公牛
senses.example: Bullocks pulled the ploughs before tractors arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 拖拉机出现之前，犁地全靠役牛。
senses.why: Castration makes the bull docile, so the young bull becomes the farm's engine.
senses.whyCN: 阉割使牛性情温顺，小公牛由此成为农庄的「发动机」，义项转向役用。

senses.title: Beef from such an animal
senses.definition: the meat of a bullock as food
senses.example: The market sold fresh bullock at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 清晨集市上出售新鲜牛肉。
senses.why: The animal name stands for its meat, as beef stands for the slaughtered ox.
senses.whyCN: 动物名转指其肉，如 beef 之于宰杀的牛。

intro.en: Bullock is an Old English compound: bull plus the diminutive suffix -oc.
intro.cn: bullock 是古英语复合词：bull 加指小后缀 -oc。

items.en: a reconstructed root gwou gave the cattle words of Europe.
items.cn: 重构词根 gwou 派生出欧洲各语言表牛的词。

items.en: bulluc meant a young bull or gelded ox, bull plus -uc.
items.cn: 古英语 bulluc 指小公牛或阉牛，bull 加 -uc 构成。

items.en: bullok settled in farming speech for draught cattle.
items.cn: 中古英语 bullok 定型为农耕用语，指役牛。

items.en: bullock carts and bullock drivers named colonial transport across Asia.
items.cn: 牛车与赶牛人成为亚洲殖民地运输的常用语。

items.en: bullock survives in farming, especially British and South Asian usage.
items.cn: 如今 bullock 存留于农业用语，多见于英国及南亚英语。

note.en: Bullock sits in the bull family and among the many English names for cattle.
note.cn: bullock 属 bull 词族，并身处英语诸牛名之间。

entries.definitionCN: 浩劫，仅结尾字母相仿，词源无关
（英俚）蠢货，同用 -ock 类后缀的俚语词

entries.definition: a castrated male cattle, American term

normalIntro.en: Shrink a bull with -ock and you get the junior version.
normalIntro.cn: 给 bull 加个指小的 -ock，就得到「小一号」的牛。

normal.en: Bullock is bull plus the old suffix -ock.
normal.cn: bullock 即 bull 加古后缀 -ock。

normal.en: The same -ock appears in hillock, a small hill.
normal.cn: 同款 -ock 见于 hillock（小丘）。

normal.en: Oxen and bullocks both pull ploughs.
normal.cn: oxen 与 bullocks 都拉犁。

normal.en: Steer is the American word for the same animal.
normal.cn: 同一牲畜的美式说法是 steer。

normal.en: Bullock cart is the classic South Asian transport.
normal.cn: 牛车是南亚经典运输工具。

abstract.en: Hear slow hooves and a creaking wooden yoke.
abstract.cn: 听缓缓的牛蹄声与吱呀的木轭。

abstract.en: See dust rise behind a cart on a dirt road.
abstract.cn: 看见土路牛车后扬起的尘土。

abstract.en: Feel the tug of a plough beginning to bite the soil.
abstract.cn: 感受犁铧破土时的一股拉力。

examples.en: A pair of bullocks hauled the logs down the hill.
examples.cn: 两头阉牛把木料拖下了山。

examples.en: He bought a young bullock at the cattle fair.
examples.cn: 他在牲口市上买了头小公牛。

examples.en: Bullock carts still carry grain in some villages.
examples.cn: 一些村庄仍用牛车运粮。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不勒克」——脖上木轭「勒」不住这头小公牛的犟劲，怎么也「不」服管。

root: bullock 由古英语 bull（公牛，上溯原始印欧语重构词根 gwou「牛」）加指小后缀 -uc/-oc 构成，本义「小公牛」，后专指阉割后的役牛；属日耳曼本土构词，与 ox 同义场。

sensesIntro.en: A young bull grows docile and becomes the farm's draught animal, then the beef on the table.
sensesIntro.cn: 小公牛被驯服为役畜，再化作餐桌上的牛肉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a yoked bullock dragging a plough.
core.cn: 核心意象：上了轭、拖着犁的役牛。

branches.en: a bullock cart on a dusty road

intro.en: The suffix -ock shrinks a noun into something smaller or younger.
intro.cn: 后缀 -ock 把名词缩小成「小号、幼年」版。

latinIntro.en: The base is Germanic; the distant cow-root is shared with Latin bos.
latinIntro.cn: 词基属日耳曼语源，远祖牛词根与拉丁语 bos 同源。

items.meaning: a wooden frame joining draught animals

latinEntries.meaningCN: 牛（与 bull 远祖同源）
